articles.title: Crypto funds see $1B in outflows as Iran tensions revive risk-off sentiment
articles.snippet: Institutional investors pulled capital from Bitcoin and Ether products as Iran tension and rising inflation rattled markets, while XRP and Solana funds continued to attract fresh inflows.

articles.title: Hyperliquid eyes 55% price rise after Silicon Valley investor's 'massive HYPE buy'
articles.snippet: A bullish long-term chart pattern puts HYPE on track for a potential rally above $70 this year, with a16z-linked accumulation and fresh institutional catalysts strengthening the case.

articles.title: 'Attractive Opportunity': Tom Lee's BitMine Adds $151 Million in Ethereum Amid Price Dip
articles.snippet: BitMine Immersion Technologies added $151 million in Ethereum amid last week's price slide, with Tom Lee citing the "attractive opportunity."
